title: Hayati Pro Max Juicy Peach Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Juicy Peach delivers the ripe, sun-soaked sweetness of fresh Peach in a smooth and fruity vape. The flavour is rich and full-bodied, capturing the soft, juicy character of real Peach with a mellow finish that makes it easy to enjoy all day. Formulated with nicotine salts for fast absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures reliable vapour production and consistently clear flavour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
